items.title: Sebi proposes Rs 50,000 fine for firms not cooperating with monitors
items.description: Sebi has proposed a fine of ₹50,000 for each instance of non-cooperation by listed companies. Monitoring agencies would be empowered to submit reports directly to stock exchanges. Stricter enforcement measures may include freezing promoters' demat accounts. Companies are required to provide information to monitoring agencies within prescribed timelines. This initiative aims to ensure better accountability regarding the utilization of funds raised through public issues.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: The Nifty index surged to close at 22,722, bouncing back with a hefty gain of 434 points from its lowest dip of the day. Positive remarks from Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman are likely to bolster investor confidence regarding the long-term capital gains tax. A decline in the India VIX suggests lower market anxiety, while foreign institutional investors recorded net sales, countered by robust domestic institutional purchases.

items.title: Stocks in news: Adani Enterprises, Hyundai Motor India, BHEL, BEL, Groww, Tata Elxsi and RailTel
items.description: Indian stocks rallied impressively, as benchmark indices surged by over 1.5%, fueled by a wave of positive investor sentiment. Key players like Adani Enterprises and Hyundai Motor India are capturing attention due to significant recent updates. While Tata Elxsi experienced a minor dip in net profit, revenue and EBIT improvements were encouraging. Furthermore, Bharat Electronics has secured fresh orders totaling Rs 533 crore, enhancing its order backlog.

items.title: GQG pares Rs 8,000 crore of Adani stakes in September quarter as FPI bets turn mixed
items.description: In a significant move, GQG Partners divested approximately ₹8,000 crore in stakes across five companies of the Adani Group during the September quarter. While some firms saw an uptick in foreign portfolio investments, others faced declines. The most substantial decrease was seen in Adani Energy Solutions, which dropped from 4.14% to 1.71%.

items.title: These 7 private and public banking stocks have an upside of up to 25% in one year, according to analysts
items.description: Thanks to the US-Iran conflict, the economy has been dealing with higher oil prices for close to seven months. And if inflation starts to creep up, its impact will be felt by many businesses, and banking would be no different.

items.title: Sebi extends IPO size flexibility by six months to March 2027
items.description: In a significant regulatory update, Sebi has extended the timeline by six months for companies to adjust their issue sizes without the need for new approvals. This applies to initial public offerings set to commence by March 31, 2027. Lead managers are now permitted to modify offer documents to accommodate these size revisions, ensuring that the main objectives continue to be met.

items.title: Ircon to monetise 4 highway assets; PSU plans to unlock 3,000cr value as part of GoI's infra monetisation
items.description: Ircon International has placed four highway assets for sale in a government-led monetisation programme. These assets include toll-road and hybrid annuity model projects located in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Karnataka, and Gujarat. The enterprise value of the assets is estimated to be around ₹3,000 crore, as advised by Axis Capital. Currently, Ircon is a Navratna company primarily earning from its railway segment.

items.title: Polycab India shares fall 6% in two sessions. What’s triggering the selloff?
items.description: Polycab India shares dropped 6% in two sessions after NSE announced its exclusion from the equity derivatives segment effective December 30. The move follows an insolvency petition admitted by NCLT over alleged dues of Rs 2.79 crore, which has since been stayed by NCLAT pending an October 26 hearing.

items.title: PL Capital picks 8 largecap stocks with upside potential of up to 41%. See full list
items.description: Following an eight-week losing streak in the Nifty, its first such run since 2001, domestic brokerage PL Capital remains cautious on the near-term market outlook. The brokerage does not expect a V-shaped recovery and does not rule out a further decline before the market enters a consolidation phase. However, the brokerage has picked 8 stocks as its top picks in its latest strategy note.

items.title: A Jigsaw Puzzle: Why Reliance Jio's IPO buzz isn’t saving RIL stock from a painful year?
items.description: Reliance Industries is gearing up for the highly anticipated Jio Platforms IPO, which is expected to generate significant capital. Despite this, recent declines in RIL shares reveal a cautious mood among investors about potential future gains. Analysts note that although the IPO could establish Jio's market valuation, immediate advantages for RIL shareholders remain unclear, given concerns about refining margins, capital needs, and core business performance affecting sentiment.

items.title: Transformers & Rectifiers shares surge over 18% as Q2 revenue jumps 61%, order inflows nearly double
items.description: Transformers & Rectifiers shares surged over 18% after the company reported a 135% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit and 61% revenue growth in Q2FY27. Order inflows nearly doubled to Rs 1,169 crore, while its unexecuted order book grew 32% year-on-year.

items.title: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers shares drop 6% after Q2 results. What’s spooking investors?
items.description: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers shares fell 6% on Wednesday despite a 50% YoY jump in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 41.94 crore. Investor sentiment was dented by margin compression as operating expenses rose 14% YoY, primarily driven by a 31% increase in employee benefit costs.

items.title: Durga's many arms: Why diversification is not dilution for investors this Navratri
items.description: Drawing inspiration from Goddess Durga’s ten arms this Navratri, Suranjana Borthakur of Mirae Asset explains why diversification is not dilution for investors. A thoughtfully allocated portfolio spread across equities, debt, and market caps provides the resilience needed to ride out volatility, prevent emotional exits, and achieve compounding growth.

items.title: Which bank stock should you buy ahead of Q2 results - HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Yes Bank or Axis Bank?
items.description: This Saturday marks an important day as HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, and Yes Bank prepare to disclose their second-quarter earnings. Notably, HDFC Bank recently appointed a new CEO amidst lackluster previous earnings that failed to satisfy investors. Analysts highlight HDFC and ICICI's robust deposit growth and solid balance sheets as key focus areas.

items.title: 5 years, no returns: Are these 9 Nifty bluechip stocks finally ready for a turnaround?
items.description: Investors are witnessing notable losses in well-known blue-chip stocks such as TCS, Infosys, and Hindustan Unilever. These major players are encountering significant hurdles affecting their market position. Analysts believe that lowered expectations may allow for potential recovery if economic conditions improve. Currently, various sectors, especially IT and consumer goods, face cyclical and structural challenges, suggesting that large-cap stocks are becoming increasingly appealing as earnings growth rates stabilize.

items.title: Tata Elxsi shares jump 7% after Q2 results, but Morgan Stanley, Motilal Oswal reiterate bearish calls
items.description: Tata Elxsi shares rallied up to 7% after the company reported 10% year-on-year profit growth and 15% revenue growth in the September quarter. Morgan Stanley, Motilal Oswal and JM Financial maintained cautious ratings, citing valuations, European automotive weakness and a gradual deal ramp-up.

items.title: Hero Motors shares soar 8% as Q2 net profit more than doubles to Rs 10 crore
items.description: Hero Motors shares jumped after the company reported a 115% YoY rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 10.2 crore. Revenue from operations grew 25% to Rs 319 crore, while total income rose 22% to Rs 322.64 crore. However, net profit fell 31% sequentially, while total expenses increased 19% YoY to Rs 307.06 crore.

items.title: Bandhan Bank among 5 stocks showing White Marubozu pattern
items.description: On October 13, five Nifty500 stocks that gained over 5% appeared on StockEdge’s White Marubozu bullish scanner.A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in which the opening price is the lowest and the closing price is the highest for the period. It is represented by a long white or green candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow, reflecting strong upward price momentum during the session.

items.title: RBL Bank among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of October 13, four stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a rise of more than 10% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session, according to StockEdge F&O scan data. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This may reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of their existing positions.

items.title: Jewellery stocks ahead of festive season: Can Q2 deliver sustained growth amid rising rates, bond yields?
items.description: Indian jewellery stocks present a mixed picture ahead of the festive season. Despite rising gold prices and macro headwinds, Q2 business updates show robust revenue growth. With the festive calendar shifting demand to Q3, analysts weigh in on valuations, earnings trajectory, and top stock picks for H2FY27.

items.title: eClerx Services among 4 stocks that closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On October 13, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 3% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: TCS among 5 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On October 13, five stocks from the Nifty500 pack that gained over 6% appeared in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.The scan identifies stocks whose RSI values have crossed above 50 from below, indicating strengthening momentum. The Relative Strength Index is a technical indicator commonly used by traders to assess price momentum and trend strength.

items.title: Aegis Logistics shares rise 3% after firm acquires 90% stake worth $809 million in Tristar Holdings
items.description: Aegis Logistics agreed to acquire an 89.9% stake in Tristar Holdings for $809 million, expanding its global energy logistics operations. The acquisition, subject to regulatory approvals, is expected to close in the fourth quarter of the current fiscal year and broaden Aegis’s geographic reach, service offerings and profitability.

items.title: Want an early signal on the economy and stocks this festive season? Watch 19 stocks, and what their managements say in the next 20 days
items.description: There is a set of companies that sees the shape of the economy before economists do. They know when a household decides to spend or hold back; to buy better things or cheaper ones. This festive season, what these companies sell, and what they say about it afterwards, will tell you more about where consumption is headed than any official number. Watch them closely. Check out Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, for price targets of over 4,000 listed stocks along with detailed company analysis focusing on five key components – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum – to generate standardised scores. SR+ Reports is a complimentary offering to ETPrime members.

items.title: Indian families keep just 14% abroad, global peers 30-40%: Prithipal Singh on going global
items.description: The world has shifted from chasing efficiency to controlling supply chains, says Prithipal Singh, Director and Head of Business Development at Aequitas Investment Consultancy, at the ET Alpha Wealth Summit. Markets like Korea and Taiwan have surged, yet Indian family offices keep only 14% abroad, mostly in property, against 30-40% for global peers.

items.title: D-Street's proxy AI trade shines in a bleak year for stocks
items.description: India's Nifty 50 index faces considerable challenges this year, with a significant drop since January. In contrast, stocks linked to artificial intelligence have thrived, attracting investor interest and increased foreign ownership. Companies are investing in the foundational infrastructure for AI, anticipating a fourfold rise in data center capacity by 2029. However, experts warn that lofty valuations could pose risks for future earnings.

items.title: PMS Tracker: HEM Securities’ SME stars, others rally up to 7.5% in September despite Nifty’s 6% crash
items.description: Despite Nifty and Sensex tumbling over 6% in September, small-cap and SME-focused PMS strategies delivered robust positive returns. Hem Securities' India Rising SME Stars scheme led gains at 7.23%, according to PMS Bazaar data, while broad mid-cap and thematic strategies suffered losses of up to 10.16%.

items.title: AI: A Boon or a threat for future? Atul Suri | Ravi Dharamshi | Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0
items.description: "You will not be replaced by AI, you will be replaced by analysts using better AI" says Ravi Dharamshi, Founder & CIO, ValueQuest explains why the real edge lies not in competing with AI, but in knowing how to use it better.

items.title: UBS says CarTrade Tech’s OLX buy can deliver 5x revenue in five years. Here’s why
items.description: Global brokerage firm UBS maintained a Buy rating on CarTrade Tech with a target price of Rs 4,000, citing strong monetisation potential in its OLX India business. UBS expects OLX’s emerging revenue levers, such as financing, subscriptions, and logistics to drive a 5x revenue expansion to Rs 11.8 billion by FY31.

items.title: IDBI Bank shares rally 13%, market value swells by Rs 11,460 crore amid muted market. What lies ahead?
items.description: IDBI Bank shares surged nearly 13%, adding over Rs 11,460 crore to its market capitalisation amid progress in the privatisation process. The bank reported strong Q2FY27 business growth, while JM Financial highlighted loan growth, deposit mobilisation and margin pressures across the banking sector.

items.title: Bank of Baroda shares drop 3% after NMC Healthcare founder BR Shetty files $15 bn lawsuit; lender issues clarification
items.description: Bank of Baroda shares fell over 3% to Rs 230.40 on Wednesday following reports that NMC Healthcare founder BR Shetty filed a $15 billion lawsuit against the lender in the Bombay High Court alleging fraud. Bank of Baroda clarified to exchanges that it has not yet been served.

items.title: Sensex falls over 250 points, Nifty closes below 22,650 even as IT stocks shine. What lies ahead for Dalal Street?
items.description: Indian equities traded nearly flat after a sharp rally in the previous session, with IT stocks extending gains while pharma shares declined. Analysts flagged elevated US bond yields and crude oil prices as headwinds, even as short-covering and hopes of tax relief supported sentiment.

items.title: TCS, HCL Tech, Infosys shares surge up to 11% in 2 days; Nifty IT soars 2,000 points. More steam left for rally?
items.description: Indian IT stocks rallied as concerns over AI-driven disruption eased, triggering an “anti-AI” trade. The Nifty IT index surged over 2,000 points in two sessions to cross 30,000, its first move above the mark in nearly a month. HCL Tech gained nearly 11% in two days following its Q2 results, while TCS and Infosys rose 6–10%.

items.title: Barclays plans India equity advisory return after a decade
items.description: Barclays plans to restart its equity capital markets business in India after nearly a decade, targeting the country’s booming IPO market. Strong fundraising demand, robust retail investment flows and startup growth offer opportunities. With hundreds of companies awaiting IPO approvals, the bank aims to expand its equity advisory and underwriting services.

items.title: Dynamatic Technologies among 7 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 32% in a month
items.description: Benchmark Sensex slipped 252 points to close at 72,781 on Wednesday. Despite the market decline, seven stocks from the BSE 1000 index touched fresh 52-week highs, reaching their highest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the previous 12 months and may indicate increased investor interest and trading activity.

items.title: Sebi proposes market cap-based SME IPO norms, seeks public comments on regulatory overhaul
items.description: Sebi has proposed a sweeping overhaul of SME IPO regulations, including market capitalisation-based eligibility thresholds, higher profitability requirements, lower minimum application values and changes to allotment norms. The proposals also cover underwriting, market making, lock-in periods and migration to the main board. Public comments are invited until November 4, 2026.

items.title: Market wrap:  Nestle India, Infosys, Shriram Finance, HDFC Life top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Wednesday
items.description: Indian equities closed lower on Wednesday as investors booked profits ahead of key US inflation data. The Nifty 50 fell 0.44% to 22,623, while the Sensex declined 0.34% to 72,782. Nestle India and Infosys led Nifty gainers, while Shriram Finance and HDFC Life topped the losers’ list.

items.title: 10 Nifty500 stocks that have fallen up to 58% in a year
items.description: The Indian equity market has witnessed considerable weakness over the past year, with the benchmark Nifty 50 declining 10% and the broader Nifty 500 index slipping 5%. However, the correction has been significantly sharper in several individual stocks. Within the Nifty 500 universe, around 50 stocks have plunged more than 30% over the past 12 months, reflecting the pressure faced by several companies despite the broader market's relatively moderate decline. Among these, 10 stocks have emerged as notable laggards, with losses ranging from 47% to 58% over the past year. Here is a closer look at these stocks and their steep declines. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Rs 5 lakh crore worth FII outflows since 2024 capital gains tax hike wreak havoc on Dalal Street. Is a reversal on the cards?
items.description: Foreign investors have sold over Rs 5 lakh crore of Indian equities since the 2024 capital gains tax hike, with outflows intensifying in 2026. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman’s comments on LTCG and STT have revived hopes of tax relief, but analysts remain divided on whether any rejig can trigger a sustained FII comeback.

items.title: These mid-caps have ‘strong buy’ & ‘buy’ recos and an upside potential of over 25%, according to analysts
items.description: Why should one be careful of the market at this juncture? One reason is that stocks are still not cheap. Even after all the nervousness of the past over two years, valuations have not come down to levels where you can say you are getting a bargain. When you buy something that is not cheap, you have less room for error, because the price already assumes things will go well.

items.title: Sebi confirms interim curbs on Rajesh Exports, says financial disclosure concerns remain unresolved
items.description: Sebi has confirmed interim restrictions on Rajesh Exports and promoter Rajesh Mehta, citing unresolved concerns over financial disclosures, possible misrepresentation and the routing of company funds through personal accounts. The regulator said gaps in consolidated revenue disclosures and missing supporting records remain, while directing the company to maintain accurate financial and related-party disclosures.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
items.description: Sensex and Nifty ended lower on Wednesday as investors booked profits after the previous session’s rally, with caution ahead of US inflation data weighing on sentiment. Market participants will track global cues, crude oil prices, foreign investor flows and stock-specific developments on Thursday, alongside buying and selling trends across key counters.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A defence tech company for an 8% upmove, a mid-cap IT stock for an almost 7% gain
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.
